note: Small campground off Hwy 16 about 35 km E of Hinton, run for Alberta Parks by the Fox Creek Development Association (West Fraser). Seven drive-in sites in spruce beside a gravel lot and boat launch; the other two are boat-in only. Day use with picnic sites by the launch. Bring drinking water (the pump is not potable). --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks (Apr 17, 2026) + West Fraser: C$20 FCFS, 9 sites (7 drive-in, 2 boat-in), non-potable pump, vault toilets confirmed; season 05-01..10-31 added; directions corrected (35 km E of Hinton, not 34 km N); lakefront -> lakeview recommended.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, checked hard): RECOMMEND lakeview. On imagery (Esri, ~0.44 m/px) the campground is a small gravel lot in dense spruce, with a lane to the boat launch at the shore ~30-40 m NE. The only open ground at the water is the launch and a grassy strip running NW along the shore behind a tree line (the West Fraser 'Day use with 4 picnic sites'). The one camp unit visible sits in the trees ~55 m from the shore, with spruce and the day-use strip between. No site numbers are published to place. The lake is visible from the lot down the launch lane, so lakeview rather than not waterfront.
